notes.title: Bugs fixed and update Steam achievements.
notes.content:
Hello there, now you can unlock Silver blue's steam achievements. Also fixed few minor bugs, typos and wrong spelling names.

If you find any bugs and want to report, please send me a mail to: kimmeomeo1992@gmail.com

Best regards, 

Cain.

notes.title: Silver blue has been released!
notes.content:
Hello there! Silver Blue is available to download now! Don't miss the chance to get the game with 20% discount!

Note: if you played our old demo (the one was uploaded before 8/11/2022), please delete the old data to make sure the full version of the game works smoothly. Sorry for the inconvenience!

I know this game might have lots of flaws, but I hope it at least could bring you some fun!

Thank you so much for stopping by!

Cain.
